entities.name: Bifunctional IspD/IspF
observations: The 376-aa query protein has 65.3–70.5% identity and ~99.5% coverage to reviewed bacterial IspD/IspF homologs.
Pfam detects IspD PF01128 at residues 6–215 and YgbB PF02542 at residues 220–373, consistent with tandem IspD/IspF catalytic modules.
Predicted molecular weight is 39.5 kDa and theoretical pI is 6.16.
The enzyme is associated with a divalent metal cation cofactor.
It functions in the methylerythritol phosphate pathway of isoprenoid biosynthesis.

entities.name: MEP cytidylyltransferase reaction
observations: 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 4-phosphate reacts with CTP to form 4-CDP-2-C-methyl-D-erythritol and diphosphate; EC 2.7.7.60; Rhea RHEA:13429.

entities.name: ME-CPP synthase reaction
observations: 4-CDP-2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2-phosphate is converted to 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2,4-cyclic diphosphate with release of CMP; EC 4.6.1.12; Rhea RHEA:23864.
This reaction is the IspF step of the methylerythritol phosphate pathway.

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid pathway
observations: The protein participates in isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthesis via the DXP/MEP pathway, corresponding to pathway steps 2 and 4 of 6.
